en: A sepia-toned vintage image depicting an ornate, Eastern-influenced structure with arches and two small domes, set against a rocky, mountainous backdrop with scattered trees and rustic buildings. Several people are pictured around the structure. The scene appears to be from the early 20th century and has a characteristic feel of Mediterranean or Balkan towns. The website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' is visible.
